scope: translation-toolkit repository plus an anonymized convenience sample of discoverable sibling article directories

repository.working_tree: stabilization changes present and not committed

definitions.multiple_renderings: Group by trim(zh), exclude blank zh/en, and require COUNT(DISTINCT trim(en)) > 1.
definitions.approved_dot: Count distinct trim(zh) where source = 'DoT定稿' and zh is non-empty.

read_only_sql.distinct_nonempty_chinese_terms: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT trim(zh)) FROM terms WHERE trim(coalesce(zh, '')) <> '';
read_only_sql.multiple_renderings: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT trim(zh) FROM terms WHERE trim(coalesce(zh, '')) <> '' AND trim(coalesce(en, '')) <> '' GROUP BY trim(zh) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT trim(en)) > 1);
read_only_sql.approved_dot: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT trim(zh)) FROM terms WHERE source = 'DoT定稿' AND trim(coalesce(zh, '')) <> '';

convenience_sample.selection: All directories discoverable in the adjacent workspace snapshot that contained both source.dj and target.dj; repository examples were excluded.

baseline.interpretation: The two digit failures were later diagnosed as false positives. Categories overlap and must not be summed.

post_stabilization.interpretation: The three digit warnings are legitimate Chinese-number-to-Arabic-digit renderings that remain visible for human verification; missing governance records remain explicit SKIP in draft mode.

limitations: This is a convenience sample for finding mechanisms, not a random or representative sample of all translations.
No project names, manuscript lines, or semantic quality judgments are stored in this evidence file.
Mechanical pass rates do not measure Buddhist doctrinal accuracy, faithfulness, fluency, or citation-version correctness.

pytest.skip_reason: Fish runtime tests skipped because Fish is not installed locally; static wrapper tests ran and Woodpecker CI installs Fish.
